reason: A Windows desktop shell for the DeepSeek Harness web interface, with local server hosting or reuse, tray behavior, session sharing, and packaging utilities.

summaries.zh: 将官方 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面封装为支持托盘驻留、服务器复用和会话互通的 Windows 桌面应用。
summaries.en: A Windows desktop shell for the official DeepSeek Harness web interface with tray residency, server reuse, and shared sessions.

capabilities: Embeds and displays the official DeepSeek Harness web interface
Hosts or reuses a local DeepSeek Harness server
Runs as a Windows desktop application with tray residency and automatic restart
Packages and launches local application components
